recognize_zh: 這是 PNH 高靈敏度流式細胞分析的門控圖：以 CD15 對側向散射（SS）區分 CD15 強陽性、高 SS 的顆粒球（藍）、低 SS 的單核球（紅）與淋巴球（綠），之後再分別評估各族群的 FLAER 與 GPI 錨定抗原。
features: Dot plot of CD15-PC5 (x) versus side scatter (y) gated on singlets
Granulocyte gate (blue): bright CD15 with intermediate-to-high side scatter, the dominant population
Monocyte gate (red): CD15-negative to dim with low-intermediate side scatter
Lymphocyte gate (green): CD15-negative with lowest side scatter
Scattered ungated events between populations; no GPI-linked marker displayed on this plot
describe_en: Flow cytometry dot plot of CD15 versus side scatter, gated on singlet leukocytes, illustrates the gating strategy for PNH analysis. Granulocytes (blue) are identified as bright CD15-positive events with intermediate to high side scatter, monocytes (red) as CD15-negative to dim events with low-intermediate side scatter, and lymphocytes (green) as CD15-negative events with the lowest side scatter. This plot does not itself demonstrate a PNH clone; the gated granulocytes and monocytes are subsequently evaluated for FLAER and GPI-anchored antigens such as CD24 and CD14.
